source: FIGURES.md adapted from people to clubs, 10 September 2026. S1 search demand (Ahrefs overview on club names); S2 also_talk_about on 'best clubs in berlin'; S3 People Also Ask; S4 the consensus lists actually read (RA's 2026 guide, Time Out, tv-turm.de); S5 history (en/de Wikipedia for Tresor, Berghain, E-Werk, KitKatClub, Bar 25, Kater Blau, Watergate, Wilde Renate, Sisyphos; the VICE interview with Felix Denk); S6 the catalogue, which has no venue field and so cannot count sets per club. Rule: required means 3+ sources or S5 at all. Sisyphos is required by owner decision. Clubs are listed as records so the audit checks every one is named; none of them is a record, so none carries an embed of its own.
